title: A Treatise on Turned Chances
summary: A treatise on turning a bad chance against the one who made it and on the blows that fall when luck has been bent.

title: The Canon of the Woven Hour
summary: A canon of the loom of the coming hour in which the threads of the field are woven into a cloth the student can read and cut.

title: Manual of the Paired Fates
summary: A manual of two fates held side by side so that the user may take one and give the other to the foe.

title: Hawk's Treatise on the Falling Lot
summary: A treatise on the lot that drops like a hawk upon its mark and on the clear foresight that guides the stoop.

title: The Wind-Sworn Reckoning of Omens
summary: A reckoning of the omens that a wind-sworn student reads and swears to answer with an exact stroke or guard.

title: Oath-Book of the Bearing Fate
summary: A book of the bearing taken upon one's own fate and held true through every turn of the fight.
